Description.Title: Pathogen: clinical or host-associated sample from Klebsiella pneumoniae

Comment.Paragraph: The isolate Klebsiella pneumoniae UHI1660 was obtained from an infectious association of a war wound, the treatment of which is described in the article Valihurskyi et al. (2026) Successful management of a combat-related limb co-infection caused by blaOXA48- and blaNDM-coproducing XDR Klebsiella pneumoniae and XDR Pseudomonas aeruginosa using azithromycin-meropenem combination therapy: a case report.
